title: Key Dependence of the 832-Round Trivium Superpoly
summary: A cube superpoly was recovered for 832-round Trivium, but whether it is key-dependent and permits partial key recovery rather than only distinguishing remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For Todo et al.'s proposed attack on $832$-round Trivium, the superpoly of a size-$72$ cube was recovered with preprocessing time $2^{77}$. Determine whether this superpoly depends on the key: key dependence would permit extraction of at most one key-bit expression, whereas key independence would leave only a distinguisher.

scope.domain: Cube cryptanalysis of the 832-round reduced variant of Trivium.
parameters: 2^77: preprocessing time for recovering the superpoly
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the recovered superpoly depends on the key; key dependence would permit extraction of at most one key-bit expression, while key independence would leave only a distinguisher.

citations.label: Correlation Cube Attacks: From Weak-Key Distinguisher to Key Recovery

progress.summary: The source presents the earlier result as a possible partial key recovery and leaves both key dependence and key independence as possible outcomes.
citation_labels: Meicheng Liu et al., Correlation Cube Attacks: From Weak-Key Distinguisher to Key Recovery
